name: Crossgrain
tagline: Trick-taking where the suit you must follow can swing mid-trick.
core_loop: Follow the current suit or cut by matching the previous card's rank to swing the suit; the highest live card holds the 1-point grain token, and when the trick closes its holder wins and scores one more point per extra live card.
win_condition: Most points after the fixed number of hands (trick points plus a 3-point most-tricks bonus each hand); ties broken by tricks won, then most recent trick won, then lowest seat.
